description: Build a link that opens fractals.slopped.site on one exact view: a family (Mandelbrot, Julia, Burning Ship, ferns, L-system plants, the Mandelbulb and 20 more), its parameters, a palette, and where to look. Use when someone wants to see or share a particular fractal. Numbers out of range are clamped to the family’s limits. Returns the link and what it shows. Centre and zoom: x and y are the point in the middle, zoom is half the screen’s shorter side in the fractal’s units (smaller is deeper); for the 3D families x is the yaw, y the pitch and zoom the camera distance.

params.description: The family’s own parameters (e.g. it for detail, cr and ci for a Julia set’s c); anything left out keeps its default.

a.description: Step (a) (0.5 to 1.5; the family's range wins)

ci.description: c, imaginary part (-1.1 to 1.1; the family's range wins)

cr.description: c, real part (-1.6 to 0.6; the family's range wins)

d.description: Roots (n) (3 to 7; the family's range wins)

it.description: Detail (iterations) (50 to 800; the family's range wins)

k.description: Scale (-2.6 to -1.6; the family's range wins)

n.description: Power (2 to 12; the family's range wins)

p.description: p (0.3 to 0.7; the family's range wins)

q.description: q (-0.8 to 0; the family's range wins)

ratio.description: Branch length (0.55 to 0.78; the family's range wins)

seed.description: Seed (1 to 999; the family's range wins)

speed.description: Drift (0 to 1; the family's range wins)

spread.description: Branch angle (0.15 to 1.2; the family's range wins)

w.description: Warp (0 to 8; the family's range wins)

zoom.description: Half the shorter side of the screen in the fractal’s units; smaller is deeper.

name: fractal_link
title: Make a fractals.slopped.site link
